sn35.149:1.3: Katamā ca sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā || || 3
sn35.149:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Cakkhum anattā ti passati || Rūpā anattā ti passati || Cakkhuviññāṇam anattāti passati || Cakkhusamphasso anattā ti passati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ || tampi Anattā ti passati || || 4-7 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā anattāti passati || || Kāyo || || 8
sn35.149:1.5: Mano anattāti passati || Dhammā anattāti passati || Manoviññāṇaṃ || Manosamphasso || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhum asukhaṃ vā tam pi anattāti passati || || 9
sn35.149:1.6: Ayaṃ kho sā bhikkhave nibbānasappāyā paṭipadāti || || 2
